title: 第9章 林雄的怒火第10章 变故
content_zh:
这是一门符师之道的精神秘法。
想修炼符师之道，需要先觉醒精神力。
精神力的强弱，和两个有关，第一个是灵魂意志，你的灵魂意志越强，精神力潜力就越高。
除此之外，精神力还和符典有关。
符典就如同修炼的功法，能够将一份力量，发挥出两份的爆发力。
这小灵符术，就是一门灵符师级的符典，此符典能够锤炼精神力，让觉醒的精神力更为的凝练。
并且，此术能够凝练出“灵符印记”，一共有五个层次。
凝练一道灵符印记为入门、两道灵符印记为小成、三道灵符印记为大成、四道为圆满、五道为大圆满。
除此之外，《小灵符术》还可以化作小灵符阵，不过灵符剑阵就麻烦多了，至少得将小灵符术修炼到大成，三道灵印叠加，才可能施展出来。
林炎开始参悟小灵符术。
嗡！
很快，林炎就顺利完成了觉醒。
他的精神力，从无到有，然后开始暴涨。
小乘符师初期、小乘符师中期、小乘符师后期、小乘符师圆满、小乘符师大圆满……最终，林炎的精神力达到了大乘符师初期，才停止了涨动！
“没想到我居然有这么强的精神力天赋！”
林炎也是咂舌，按照小灵符术的说法，绝大多数符师初步觉醒的时候，精神力不会超过小乘后期。
能达到大圆满，已经是凤毛麟角般的天才了。
而他，却一觉醒，就是大乘初期！
这离不开他曾受的苦难，那些苦难磨炼了他的心智，让他的灵魂意志无比的强韧，甚至很多气海境修士都无法比拟。
这股精神波动，弥漫整个山洞，也引起了其他天才的关注。

林虎第一个反应过来，他脸色阴沉的望向林炎：“该死，我们都被骗了，林家老祖的传承居然在尸体身上？”
“可恶啊！我们争抢半天，原来不是真正的传承，最大的传承是林家老祖留下的那些东西！”
其他林家弟子都是一愣，而后露出悔恨之色。
先前那九道光团唤醒了他们内心的贪婪，让他们蒙蔽了眼睛，也忘记了，林家老祖的传承才是最值钱的。
他们抢的这些宝物，和林炎得到的机缘，根本无法相提并论！
林虎自然不甘心，他低吼道：“林炎，将林家老祖的传承交出来，不然的话别怪我不客气！”
“咱们两个之间的关系，还有客气一说么？”
林炎嘴角泛起冷笑。
林虎一愣，而后也露出残忍的笑：
“也对！反正迟早要杀你！既然你抢了老祖的传承，那我就先宰了你，传承最后还是我的！”
轰！
下一刻，林虎身上，爆发出了滔天的气势。
那是气海境一重的修为波动！
“这个世界，始终是强者为尊，弱者就算得到了机缘，也根本守不住。”
望着这一幕，其余的林家弟子们都表情冷漠，根本没打算掺和两大天才之间的争锋。
虽然林炎之前救了他们，可谁也不会为了一个将死之人，而得罪如日中天的天之骄子。
“跟我们老大斗，不自量力！”
林虎的那些小弟们则露出残忍之色。
在他们看来，林炎在进入祖地的刹那，就等于半只脚踏入棺材里了。
哪怕林炎也很优秀，可毕竟只是养气九重，而林虎却是货真价实的气海一重，养气境和气海境之间有着质变的差距！

他们还没听说过，青石城有谁家的天才，能以养气境逆伐气海境的！
content_en:
This is an exquisite and mysterious method of the Talisman Master.
If you want to practice the way of a Talisman Master, you need to awaken your spiritual power first.
The strength of mental power is related to two things. The first is soul will. The stronger your soul will, the higher the potential of mental power.
In addition, spiritual power is also related to Fudian.
Fudian is like a practice technique, which can use one part of power to exert two parts of explosive power.
This small spiritual talisman technique is a spiritual talisman master-level talisman. This talisman can temper mental power and make the awakened spiritual power more condensed.
Moreover, this technique can condense the "spiritual mark", which has five levels in total.
Condensing one spiritual talisman mark is the beginning, two spiritual talisman marks are the small success, three spiritual talisman marks are the great success, four spiritual talisman marks are the perfection, and five spiritual talisman marks are the great perfection.
In addition, the "Little Spirit Talisman Technique" can also be transformed into a Small Spirit Talisman Array, but the Spirit Talisman Sword Array is much more troublesome. You must at least practice the Little Spirit Talisman Technique to a great level and have three spiritual seals superimposed before it can be used.
Lin Yan began to understand the Little Spirit Talisman Technique.
Buzz!
Soon, Lin Yan successfully completed his awakening.
His mental power started from scratch and then began to skyrocket.
The early stage of the Hinayana Talisman Master, the middle stage of the Hinayana Talisman Master, the late stage of the Hinayana Talisman Master, the perfection of the Hinayana Talisman Master, the Great Perfection of the Hinayana Talisman Master... Finally, Lin Yan's mental power reached the early stage of the Mahayana Talisman Master, and then he stopped rising!
"I didn't expect that I have such a strong mental talent!"
Lin Yan also clicked his tongue. According to Xiaoling Talisman Technique, when most Talisman masters initially awaken, their mental power will not exceed the late Hinayana stage.
Those who can achieve Dzogchen are already as rare as a genius.
But when he woke up, he was in the early stage of Mahayana!
This is inseparable from the suffering he has suffered. Those sufferings have tempered his mind and made his soul and will extremely strong, which even many Qi Sea Realm monks cannot match.
This mental fluctuation permeated the entire cave and attracted the attention of other geniuses.
Lin Hu was the first to react. He looked at Lin Yan with a gloomy face: "Damn it, we have all been deceived. The inheritance of the ancestor of the Lin family is actually in the corpse?"
"Damn it! We fought for a long time, but it turns out it's not the real inheritance. The biggest inheritance is the things left by the ancestors of the Lin family!"
The other Lin family disciples were stunned for a moment, and then showed regret.
The nine rays of light previously awakened the greed in their hearts, blinding them and forgetting that the inheritance of the ancestors of the Lin family was the most valuable.
The treasures they grabbed were incomparable to the opportunities Lin Yan got!
Lin Hu was naturally unwilling to give in. He roared: "Lin Yan, hand over the inheritance of the ancestor of the Lin family, otherwise don't blame me for being rude!"
"Can we be polite about the relationship between the two of us?"
A sneer appeared at the corner of Lin Yan's mouth.
Lin Hu was stunned for a moment, and then showed a cruel smile:
"That's right! I'm going to kill you sooner or later anyway! Since you stole my ancestor's inheritance, I will kill you first. The inheritance will still be mine in the end!"
Boom!
The next moment, Lin Hu burst out with overwhelming momentum.
That is the fluctuation of cultivation level at the first level of Qi Sea Realm!
"In this world, the strong are always respected. Even if the weak get an opportunity, they cannot hold on to it."
Looking at this scene, the rest of the Lin family disciples had indifferent expressions and had no intention of getting involved in the fight between the two geniuses.
Although Lin Yan saved them before, no one would offend the proud man of heaven for a dying person.
"Fight with our boss, don't overestimate your own capabilities!"
Lin Hu's younger brothers showed cruel expressions.
In their opinion, the moment Lin Yan entered the ancestral land, it was as if he had half his foot in the coffin.
Even though Lin Yan is also very good, after all, he is only at the ninth level of Qi Yang, while Lin Hu is a genuine first level of Qi Sea. There is a qualitative difference between the Qi Yang and Qi Sea levels!
They haven't heard of any genius in Qingshi City who can counterattack the Qi Sea Realm with the Qi Nourishing Realm.！
